rationale.why: Adding cross-cutting behavior (telemetry, feature flags, error boundaries, custom styles) SHOULD NOT require modifying the Pattern core. Extensions are plugins that decorate a PatternDefinition with new capabilities, applied at definition time.

built-in-extensions.ext: withTelemetry({ events: ['rowSelected', 'sortChanged'] }) // Wraps `on` handlers to also emit to telemetry bus before calling user handler.
withFeatureFlag('products.table.v2') // Adds a skip-check step: if flag is off, pattern is omitted.
withCustomStyle({ slot: 'product-table' }) // Reads inventory.customStyle[slot] from context and deep-merges into Component props.
withA11y({ landmarkRole: 'region', labelKey: 'a11y.products.table' }) // Wraps Component in semantic landmark with translated label.
withPermission('products.read') // Adds permission to skip-chain; pattern omitted if session lacks permission.
withSuspenseFallback({ skeleton: ProductTableSkeleton }) // Wraps lazy boundary with custom skeleton.

invariants.invariant: Extensions are applied in declaration order at definePattern() time.
An extension MUST be pure (no side effects at apply time).
Extensions cannot replace `Component`; they can only wrap or augment.
An extension MAY add to `requires` (additional capabilities), but NOT remove.

gates.gate: Each extension has a *.extension.test.ts demonstrating apply() result.
Extension chain is detectable in DevTools (named wrapper in component tree).
